articles.title: Unitree Robotics surges 629% to US$66 billion valuation in Shanghai share debut
articles.summary: Unitree Robotics achieved a staggering 629% surge in its share price during its Shanghai debut, propelling its valuation to an impressive US$66 billion and underscoring the growing global interest in advanced robotics technology. This remarkable market performance not only highlights Unitree's position as a leader in humanoid robotics but also signals a significant shift in investor confidence towards the future of automation and AI-driven innovations.

articles.title: China’s LandSpace beats SpaceX with steel-booster recovery after orbital launch
articles.summary: China's LandSpace has achieved a groundbreaking milestone by successfully recovering a stainless-steel booster after an orbital launch, positioning itself ahead of SpaceX in the race for reusable rocket technology and significantly advancing the potential for lower-cost space access. This achievement not only establishes Zhuque-3 as China's first commercial rocket to reach orbit with a recovered first stage but also underscores the rapid evolution of the global space industry.

articles.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
articles.summary: OpenAI's new initiative aims to enhance democratic oversight of AI in national security by equipping government institutions with essential tools, training, and expertise, marking a significant step towards ensuring accountability and transparency in the deployment of advanced technologies in critical areas. This breakthrough is crucial as it addresses the growing concerns over the ethical implications and governance of AI in safeguarding national interests.

articles.title: Apple announces changes for apps in the European Union
articles.summary: Apple's announcement of revised business terms for apps in the European Union marks a significant shift in its operational strategy, reflecting its commitment to compliance with regulatory demands and potentially reshaping the app marketplace dynamics in one of the world's largest economies. This breakthrough not only demonstrates Apple's adaptability but also sets a precedent for how tech giants navigate increasingly stringent regulations.

articles.title: Meet the Chinese AI star who splashed a reported US$70m on a California mansion
articles.summary: Tony Wu Yuhuai, co-founder of Elon Musk's AI lab, has made headlines by purchasing a $70 million mansion in California, marking the largest property deal in the Bay Area this year and highlighting the significant influence of Chinese talent in the rapidly evolving AI landscape. This extravagant acquisition not only underscores the wealth generated in the tech sector but also amplifies discussions about the pivotal role of international innovators in shaping the future of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Alibaba’s lightweight Qwen model takes on larger AI systems from OpenAI, DeepSeek, Zhipu
articles.summary: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B, a lightweight AI model with 27 billion parameters, has achieved performance levels comparable to larger competitors like OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna, demonstrating that powerful AI can now be accessible on everyday hardware and signaling a significant shift in the competitive landscape of AI development. This breakthrough not only empowers local developers but also challenges the dominance of established players in the AI space.

articles.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
articles.summary: OpenAI's partnership with CodeAI marks a groundbreaking initiative to enhance AI literacy among students, equipping them with critical thinking skills and the ability to responsibly harness and influence AI technology, which is essential for navigating an increasingly automated future. This collaboration not only empowers the next generation but also sets a precedent for educational frameworks in the age of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
articles.summary: OpenAI is revolutionizing the development of frontier AI models by implementing advanced monitoring and alignment safeguards, ensuring that the pace of innovation is matched by robust security measures to mitigate potential cyber risks. This breakthrough not only enhances the safety of AI technologies but also sets a new standard for responsible advancement in the field.

articles.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT for Teens, an innovative AI tool designed to enhance critical thinking and learning among adolescents while incorporating robust safety features and parental controls, marking a significant step towards responsible AI usage in education. This breakthrough not only empowers teens to engage with technology confidently but also addresses the pressing need for protective measures in digital learning environments.

articles.title: In praise of zealotry
articles.summary:
• Early feminists challenged societal norms by embracing passionate debate over polite discourse, asserting the importance of their voices.  
• Mary Astell and Catharine Macaulay exemplified zealotry as a tool for social change, rejecting the expectation of feminine submission in intellectual discussions.  
• The essay posits that fervor in advocacy can catalyze progress, suggesting that true change often requires a departure from decorum.  
• By prioritizing conviction over civility, these feminists illuminated the power of unwavering commitment to one's beliefs in the face of opposition.  
• Ultimately, the piece advocates for the value of zealotry in activism, encouraging a re-evaluation of how passion can drive transformative dialogue.

articles.title: Asana cleared 5 years of engineering work in 2 weeks with Codex
articles.summary: Asana revolutionized its engineering process by leveraging OpenAI Codex to overhaul an outdated testing system in just two weeks, achieving what would typically require five years of work for a mere $12,000. This breakthrough not only accelerates software development timelines but also demonstrates the transformative potential of AI in optimizing operational efficiency.
